attributes.subdivision: Bread, pastry, cakes, biscuits and other bakers' wares, whether or not containing cocoa; communion wafers, empty cachets of a kind suitable for pharmaceutical use, sealing wafers, rice paper and similar products (*Quota for exports from Canada into the United Kingdom*)

attributes.rule: A change from any other heading.

A change from any other heading, provided that: 

- the net weight of non-originating material of [heading 1006](/headings/1006) or [heading 1101](/headings/1101) to [heading 1108](/headings/1108) used in production does not exceed **20%** of the net weight of the product, 

- the net weight of non-originating sugar used in production does not exceed **40%** of the net weight of the product, 

- the net weight of non-originating material of [chapter 4](/chapters/04) used in production does not exceed **20%** of the net weight of the product, *and*

- the net weight of non-originating sugar and non-originating material of [chapter 4](/chapters/04) used in production does not exceed **50%** of the net weight of the product.
